request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour the grey skin of the dinosaur to a clear cornflower blue with darker navy blue shading and navy blue stripes on the tail, with no grey skin anywhere. Change nothing else: keep the cream belly, throat, teeth and claws, the bright red feather crest, the bright red blanket, the pose, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
